plan.notes: SOURCE: Official NDSU University Catalog 2024-2025 (archived edition). Semester sequence transcribed from the official catalog 'Sample Program Guide' for Psychology (programs-study page, Total Credits: 120); course titles verified against the official Psychology requirements table (undergraduate/program-curriculum/psychology). HONESTY NOTE: NDSU labels these 'Sample Program Guide' with a disclaimer that they are not the official curriculum for current students; individual plans vary by start year, transfer credit, and course availability. This is the only semester-by-semester sequence NDSU publishes for this major. Footnote 1: 15 total credits in 400-level PSYC required; at least two courses (6 cr) from Group A and two from Group B; 3 cr may be PSYC 493 (Undergraduate Research) or PSYC 496 (Field Experience) taken for a grade. Footnote 2: students who do not take MATH 104 need 3 Quantitative Reasoning gen-ed credits as a free elective. B.S. students must complete one of four tracks (Natural Science, Social Science, Minor Program of Study, or Accelerated MPH; 14-16 credits) in consultation with an adviser. PSYC 189 required only for first-time, first-year students.
